greeting.text: ...Hello. I am Secre Swallowtail. I seal things, and I open them again. You may call me Secre.
I see. A new person. I will remember your face, {player}. I remember faces, locks and debts.
Do not stand so close. I am not angry. This is my normal face.
You are the one who put Vetto down. Then it is time for me to be here. I am Secre.
You have the look of someone who has opened many doors. I am Secre. I prefer locks.

hint.text: Gatekeeper doors answer to Mana Cores, not to hope. Beat the guardian, take the core, open the door. Hope is optional.
Locked chests exist. Branching Array opens them if you look at one from eight blocks or closer. A grimoire is faster than a key. If it is mine.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun seals people inside rituals. I know how that works. The seal is rarely the problem. The one who holds the key is.
A seal is a promise that something stays shut. Zagred keeps promises only when they please him. Do not trust a lock in front of him.
Someone opened a gate to a lower place in the Spade Kingdom, and devils walked through. The Dark Triad stand on your floors because of that. I would rather not discuss it.
Lucius Zogratis hid inside the Wizard King for years. A lock nobody knew was locked. Prince Lemiel would have been furious.
The Seven Deadly Sins are people from elsewhere. I have no seal for them. I would like that on record.
Another dungeon. More monsters behind more doors. I do not care, as long as they stay behind their doors.
Twenty fights. Hm. You are... acceptable. This is a compliment.
My four seals open only in my own grimoire: Branching Array, Eternal Prison, Wound Sealing, Orbital Bind. A borrowed book will refuse them. That is not rude. That is a lock.
Eternal Prison encases a target in a cube for six seconds. Nothing goes in, nothing comes out. A boss slips free in a second and a half. Plan for that.

Wound Sealing closes a third of an ally's wounds and clears what ails them. Orbital Bind makes an ally harder to hit with magic for half a minute, and it pairs well with an anti-magic sword. Ask Asta. Both seals are quiet. I like quiet.
The ordinary Seal page silences a mage's grimoire for five seconds. A boss's for one. Do not cast it in a panic. Time it.
Vetto is gone? Good. A thing that heals that fast should have been sealed, not fought.
Heath Grice used a relic to close his own story. A poor seal. It did not hold.
You broke Zagred's hold on the Eye. Hm. It did not hold either.
Lucius is sealed away for good. I would like to believe that. Prince Lemiel would have liked it, too.
I once sealed my lord inside a statue. It was necessary. I do not enjoy explaining it.
I used to be a bird. Black, small, loud. I preferred it, though the food was worse.
Asta is noisy. His grimoire is quiet. I like his grimoire.
I peck him when he is annoying. He deserves it. That is all I will say.
The Black Bulls are loud, dirty and unreliable. I have never been so content.
A door that does not open has a rule. Find the rule, and the door opens. Find the key, and the door opens faster.
The Crucible shows three relics and asks you to choose one. The rest turn to dust. I would choose quickly, and leave quickly.

farewell.text: Goodbye. Do not be loud on the way out.
Return safely. I dislike changing locks.
I will be here. I am always here. It is a good place to be quiet.
